PR #55 merged as 6cfa0b8d85e81ad52157f44129c7e240a44c6f45.

The shared native RDF kernel and actual Census baseline/index readers and writers
now retain PurRDF datasets and terms and delegate parsing, traversal and canonical
output. The private report graph/parser/rendering paths are removed. Explicit
report form 2 migrates both canonical formats to one normalized-body identity;
normal-form 1 fingerprint bytes remain unchanged.

Full local make check, normal signed commit hooks, independent substantive review
and all twelve hosted checks passed, including Linux/macOS/Windows runtime tests.
The real lifecycle/current judgments, original-limit fuzz runs, domain refusal
neighbors and actual parser-revision replays passed. The landed tree matches the
qualified candidate, and archived validation/review records match the reviewed
bytes. The complete delivery evidence is retained under refs/ghprsq/pr/55/stage.

The parent issues remain open. Workplan machine-output migration, sole default
coverage/adoption, Census debt/CLI/protocol, remaining native algorithm adoption
and grounded preferred-provider enforcement retain their existing requirements.
Next is the real locked PurRDF alias-to-definition source foundation, followed by
its actual Census provider rule and self-gate. No name/import-only provider claim
or parent completion is inferred from this delivered RDF unit.
